meta.label: Cloud Cost Optimizer
meta.description: Runs multi-cloud cost optimization strategies and outputs recommendations.
meta.author: Dataiku Cloud Optimizer Team

params.name: default_config_yaml
params.label: Default Agent Config (YAML)
params.description: Paste YAML (providers, strategies, thresholds). Stored as multi-line text.
params.defaultValue:
# example:
# providers:
#   aws: {}
# strategies:
#   cost:
#     min_savings_threshold: 10

params.name: aws_access_key_id
params.label: AWS Access Key ID
params.description: Optional: set explicit AWS access key for the recipe run.

params.name: aws_secret_access_key
params.label: AWS Secret Access Key
params.description: Optional: secret key associated with the above access key.

params.name: aws_session_token
params.label: AWS Session Token (STS)
params.description: Optional: session token for temporary credentials.

params.name: aws_enabled
params.label: Enable AWS Provider
params.description: Toggle AWS data collection (Cost Explorer, EC2 inventory).

params.name: aws_region
params.label: AWS Region
params.description: Primary region for EC2 inventory; Cost Explorer stays us-east-1.

params.name: aws_profile
params.label: AWS Profile (optional)
params.description: Named profile from ~/.aws/credentials; leave blank for IAM role/env vars.

params.name: llm_connection
params.label: LLM Connection (LLM Mesh)
params.description: Select a DSS LLM Mesh connection. Overrides explicit API key if provided.

params.name: openai_api_key
params.label: OpenAI API Key
params.description: Optional key for LLM summarization. Leave blank to disable.

params.name: email_recipients
params.label: Email Recipients (comma-separated)
params.description: If Email notifier implemented, list recipients.
